name: Forrest Hood James, Jr.
note: Fob James served his 1995-99 term as a Republican; his earlier 1979-83 term was as a Democrat.

name: Charlie Crist
note: Served as a Republican; left the party in 2010 and became a Democrat in 2012.

name: Sonny Perdue
note: Switched from Democrat to Republican in 1998, before his 2002 election.

name: Mark Parkinson
note: Former Republican legislator who switched to the Democratic Party in 2006 and served as a Democrat.

name: Brereton C. Jones
note: Served as a Democrat; was a Republican legislator in West Virginia earlier in his career.

name: Murphy J. Foster
note: Mike Foster switched from Democrat to Republican during the 1995 campaign and served as a Republican.

name: Jesse Ventura
note: Elected on the Reform Party ticket, later the Independence Party of Minnesota; neither major party.

name: Eric Greitens
note: Served as a Republican; was a Democrat before entering electoral politics.

name: Rick Perry
note: Served as a Republican; was a Democratic state representative until switching parties in 1989.

name: Jim Justice
note: Elected as a Democrat in 2016 but switched to the Republican Party in August 2017, serving all but seven months of the term as a Republican.
